    (r"live cockpit|curved display|navigation", "Infotainment system overall"),
    (r"lackierung|metallic|uni |exterieurpaket|spoiler|carbon|shadow line|schriftzug|kidney|niere", "Exterior design"),
    (r"travel & comfort", "Interior comfort"),
]

# Customer-facing tech data (CLAUDE.md scope: range and charging as experienced, space, performance).
TECH_METRICS = [
    (r"^Elektrische Reichweite, WLTP in km", "electric range WLTP", "km"),
    (r"^Maximale Ladeleistung DC in kW", "max DC charging power", "kW"),
    (r"^Maximale Ladeleistung AC in kW", "max AC charging power", "kW"),
    (r"^Minimale Ladedauer DC 10–80 %", "DC charging time 10-80 %", "min"),
    (r"^High-Power-Laden \(HPC\) in km", "range added in 10 min DC", "km"),
    (r"^Beschleunigung 0–100 km/h in s", "acceleration 0-100 km/h", "s"),
    (r"^Höchstgeschwindigkeit", "top speed", "km/h"),
    (r"^Gepäckraumvolumen in l", "luggage volume", "l"),
    (r"^Energieverbrauch, kombiniert WLTP in kWh/100 km", "energy consumption WLTP", "kWh/100 km"),
    (r"^Kraftstoffverbrauch, kombiniert WLTP in l/100 km", "fuel consumption WLTP", "l/100 km"),
]
_VALUE = re.compile(r"\d[\d.]*(?:,\d+)?(?:\s*–\s*\d[\d.]*(?:,\d+)?)?")


def item_feature(name: str) -> str:
    lowered = name.lower()
    for pattern, feature in ITEM_FEATURES:
        if re.search(pattern, lowered):
            return feature
    return ""


def _de_number(text: str) -> float:
    first = text.split("–")[0].strip()
    return float(first.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."))


def tech_data(vehicle: str, texts: dict[int, str], variants: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    """Rows of the technical data pages: one per metric x variant."""
    rows = []
    known = sorted(set(variants), key=len, reverse=True)
    for page, text in texts.items():
        if not text.startswith("TECHNISCHE WERTE."):
            continue
        lines = text.splitlines()
        header = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else ""
        found = []
        rest = header
        for v in known:
            idx = rest.find(v)
            if idx >= 0:
                found.append((header.find(v), v))
                rest = rest.replace(v, " " * len(v), 1)
        page_variants = [v for _, v in sorted(found)]
        if not page_variants:
            m = re.match(r"BMW \S+(?: \S+)? (.*)$", header)
            page_variants = m.group(1).split() if m else []
        for line in lines[2:]:
            for pattern, metric, unit in TECH_METRICS:
                if not re.match(pattern, line):
                    continue
                label_end = re.match(pattern, line).end()
                values = _VALUE.findall(re.sub(r"^\D*", "", line[label_end:]).strip())
                # Footnote digits glued to the label ("in km2 513 – 627") are dropped by the regex anchor.
                if len(values) > len(page_variants):
                    values = values[-len(page_variants):]
                if len(values) != len(page_variants):
                    continue
                for variant, value in zip(page_variants, values):
                    rows.append({"vehicle": vehicle, "page": page, "variant": variant, "metric": metric,
                                 "value": _de_number(value), "value_text": value, "unit": unit, "line": line})
    return rows


def write_review(vehicles=("F70", "G60", "G70")) -> dict[str, int]:
    REVIEW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    counts = {}
    names: dict[str, str] = {}
    for vehicle in vehicles:
        path = REVIEW_DIR / f"option_list_{vehicle}.csv"
        items, texts, variants = option_lists.extract(RAW_DATA_DIR / FILES[vehicle])
        rows = option_lists.rows_for_review(vehicle, items, variants)
        for it in items:
            names.setdefault(it.name, item_feature(it.name))
        if not path.exists():
            with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys()) + ["confirmed"])
                w.writeheader()
                for r in rows:
                    w.writerow({**r, "confirmed": ""})
        tech = tech_data(vehicle, texts, variants)
        tpath = REVIEW_DIR / f"tech_data_{vehicle}.csv"
        if not tpath.exists():
            with open(tpath, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(tech[0].keys()) + ["confirmed"] if tech else ["confirmed"])
                w.writeheader()
                for r in tech:
                    w.writerow({**r, "confirmed": ""})
        counts[vehicle] = {"items": len(items), "rows": len(rows), "variants": len(variants), "tech": len(tech)}
    fpath = REVIEW_DIR / "option_features.csv"
    if not fpath.exists():
        with open(fpath, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            w = csv.writer(f)
            w.writerow(["item_name", "proposed_feature", "proposed_by", "confirmed"])
            for name, feature in sorted(names.items()):
                w.writerow([name, feature, PROPOSED_BY, ""])
    counts["distinct_items"] = len(names)
    counts["mapped_items"] = sum(1 for f in names.values() if f)
    return counts


def _read_csv(name: str) -> list[dict]:
    with open(REVIEW_DIR / name, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def load(conn, run_id, feature_ids: dict[str, str], vehicles=("F70", "G60", "G70")) -> dict[str, int]:
    item_feature_map = {r["item_name"]: r["proposed_feature"] for r in _read_csv("option_features.csv")}
    counts = {"pages": 0, "vehicle_feature": 0, "tech": 0, "option_codes": 0}
    for vehicle in vehicles:
        raw_ref = store_raw_file(FILES[vehicle])
        _, texts, _ = option_lists.extract(RAW_DATA_DIR / FILES[vehicle])
        pages = [{
            "record_id": f"option_list-{vehicle}-p{page}", "source_id": "option_list", "category": "E",
            "content_type": "reference", "level": "model", "url": f"{FILES[vehicle]}#page={page}", "raw_ref": raw_ref,
            "brand": "BMW", "chassis_code": vehicle, "vehicle_role": "current", "country": "DE", "market": "Europe",
            "language": "de", "title": f"Option list {vehicle}, page {page}", "text_original": text,
            "extra": {"edition": "July 2026", "page": page},
            "content_hash": hashlib.sha256(f"option_list|{vehicle}|{page}|{text}".encode()).hexdigest(),
            "run_id": run_id,
        } for page, text in texts.items() if text.strip()]
        counts["pages"] += audit.insert_many(conn, "source_record", pages, actor="seed:option_list",
                                             key="record_id", run_id=run_id,
                                             rationale="option-list page text (provided PDF)")
        rows = []
        codes = set()
        for r in _read_csv(f"option_list_{vehicle}.csv"):
            feature = item_feature_map.get(r["item_name"]) or ""
            rows.append({
                "vehicle": vehicle, "feature_id": feature_ids.get(feature), "variant": r["variant"], "market": "DE",
                "availability": r["availability"], "sa_code": r["sa_code"] or None, "item_name": r["item_name"],
                "price_eur": float(r["price_eur"]) if r["price_eur"] else None, "package": r["package"] or None,
                "record_id": f"option_list-{vehicle}-p{r['page']}",
            })
            if r["sa_code"] and feature:
                codes.add((feature, r["sa_code"]))
        counts["vehicle_feature"] += audit.insert_many(conn, "vehicle_feature", rows, actor="seed:option_list",
                                                       run_id=run_id, rationale="option-list grid (review CSV)")
        counts["option_codes"] += audit.insert_many(conn, "feature_mapping", [
            {"feature_id": feature_ids[f], "kind": "option_code", "value": code, "vehicle": vehicle}
            for f, code in sorted(codes) if f in feature_ids
        ], actor="seed:option_list", on_conflict_do_nothing=True, rationale="option code of a mapped item")
        tech = [{
            "record_id": f"option_list-{vehicle}-{r['variant'].replace(' ', '_')}-{r['metric'].replace(' ', '_')}",
            "source_id": "option_list", "category": "E", "url": f"{FILES[vehicle]}#page={r['page']}",
            "raw_ref": raw_ref, "brand": "BMW", "model": r["variant"], "chassis_code": vehicle, "country": "DE",
            "market": "Europe", "period": "2026-07", "metric": r["metric"], "value": float(r["value"]),
            "value_text": r["value_text"], "unit": r["unit"], "source_location": f"page {r['page']}: {r['line']}",
            "run_id": run_id,
        } for r in _read_csv(f"tech_data_{vehicle}.csv")]
        counts["tech"] += audit.insert_many(conn, "data_record", tech, actor="seed:option_list", key="record_id",
                                            run_id=run_id, on_conflict_do_nothing=True,
                                            rationale="customer-facing technical data (option list)")
    return counts

"""Seed the database from the provided BMW data: python -m app.seed.run

Steps run in order, each in its own transaction with an agent_run row; a step
that already finished (agent_run status ok) is skipped, so the command is safe
to re-run. ``--review`` only (re)writes the review CSVs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
from collections import Counter

from app import audit, db
from app.llm.client import Usage, current_usage
from app.seed import catalog, catalog_proposal, loaders, option_load, readers, registry

DEFAULT_WEIGHTS = {
    "distinct_customers": 0.25, "severity": 0.20, "satisfaction_gap": 0.15, "competitor_gap": 0.15,
    "market_volume": 0.10, "removed_vs_predecessor": 0.05, "reach": 0.05, "trend": 0.05,
}
PROFILES = [
    ("balanced", DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, {"S": 1.0, "M": 0.85, "L": 0.7}, True),
    ("customer voice", {**DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, "distinct_customers": 0.35, "severity": 0.25, "competitor_gap": 0.05,
                        "market_volume": 0.05, "trend": 0.0}, {"S": 1.0, "M": 0.85, "L": 0.7}, False),
    ("competition", {**DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, "competitor_gap": 0.30, "distinct_customers": 0.15, "severity": 0.15,
                     "trend": 0.10}, {"S": 1.0, "M": 0.85, "L": 0.7}, False),
    ("budget", DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, {"S": 1.0, "M": 0.7, "L": 0.4}, False),
]
DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS = {
    "open_min_customers": 10, "conflict_min_customers": 5, "conflict_negative_share": 0.6,
    "similarity_feature": {"openai": 0.45, "local": 0.30}, "similarity_case": {"openai": 0.55, "local": 0.35},
    "reach_cap": 100000, "competitor_gap_min_rivals": 1,
}
BRAND_PROFILE_V1 = """# BMW brand profile (assumption, version 1)

Status: **assumption**, written from the PM interviews on 2026-10-10. BMW has no single documented source of truth for brand taste; the PM edits this profile and every change is versioned.

- **Sporty, driving dynamics:** rear-wheel-drive character, precise steering, "Freude am Fahren".
- **Design:** distinctive exterior and interior design; evolution, not reinvention.
- **Efficiency:** efficient powertrains, range and charging that keep up with the best rivals.
- **Premium quality and technology:** high-quality materials, intuitive operation, digital services that work.

Off-brand examples: features that trade driving dynamics for gimmicks, or luxury-only items far above the segment of the line.
"""


def _run(agent: str, fn, *args, force: bool = False):
    with db.transaction() as conn:
        done = conn.execute(
            "select 1 from agent_run where agent = %s and status = 'ok' limit 1", (agent,)
        ).fetchone()
        if done and not force:
            print(f"skip {agent} (already seeded)")
            return None
        run = conn.execute(
            "insert into agent_run (agent, mode) values (%s, 'seed') returning id", (agent,)
        ).fetchone()["id"]
    usage = Usage()
    token = current_usage.set(usage)
    try:
        with db.transaction() as conn:
            result = fn(conn, run, *args)
            records = result.get("records", 0) if isinstance(result, dict) else (result or 0)
            conn.execute(
                "update agent_run set status = 'ok', ended_at = now(), records_fetched = %s, signals_valid = %s,"
                " signals_quarantined = %s, llm_tokens = %s, llm_cost_usd = %s, params = %s where id = %s",
                (records, (result or {}).get("signals", 0) - (result or {}).get("quarantined", 0)
                 if isinstance(result, dict) else 0,
                 (result or {}).get("quarantined", 0) if isinstance(result, dict) else 0,
                 usage.tokens, usage.cost_usd, json.dumps({"result": result, "llm": usage.by_prompt}, default=str),
                 run),
            )
    except Exception as exc:
        with db.transaction() as conn:
            conn.execute("update agent_run set status = 'failed', ended_at = now(), error = %s where id = %s",
                         (repr(exc)[:2000], run))
        raise
    finally:
        current_usage.reset(token)
    print(f"{agent}: {result}")
    return result


def step_reference(conn, run):
    n_areas = catalog.load_car_areas(conn)
    counts = registry.load(conn)
    return {"car_areas": n_areas, **counts}


def step_features(conn, run):
    ids = catalog.load_features(conn)
    return {"features": len(ids)}


def step_configs(conn, run):
    """Competitor markets, brand profile, one config per valid vehicle x market, weight profiles."""
    vehicles = conn.execute("select code, markets_sold from vehicle where is_current").fetchall()
    data = registry.REGISTRY_YAML.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    import yaml

    not_sold = {(c["bmw_vehicle"], c["brand"], c["model"]): c["not_sold_in"]
                for c in yaml.safe_load(data)["competitors"]}
    sold = {v["code"]: v["markets_sold"] for v in vehicles}
    for c in conn.execute("select id, bmw_vehicle, brand, model from competitor").fetchall():
        markets = [m for m in sold.get(c["bmw_vehicle"], []) if m not in not_sold.get(
            (c["bmw_vehicle"], c["brand"], c["model"]), []) and m != "Rest of World"]
        audit.update(conn, "competitor", {"id": c["id"]}, {"markets": markets}, actor="seed:configs",
                     rationale="markets of the BMW line minus 'not sold in' notes (fetching-sources 2.3)")
    profile = audit.insert(conn, "brand_profile", {"version": 1, "body_md": BRAND_PROFILE_V1,
                                                   "created_by": "seed:configs"},
                           actor="seed:configs", rationale="initial brand profile (assumption)")
    configs = 0
    for v in vehicles:
        for market in v["markets_sold"]:
            comps = [str(r["id"]) for r in conn.execute(
                "select id from competitor where bmw_vehicle = %s and %s = any(markets) and confirmed",
                (v["code"], market)).fetchall()]
            cfg = audit.insert(conn, "config", {
                "name": f"{v['code']} / {market}", "vehicle": v["code"], "market": market,
                "competitor_ids": comps, "brand_profile_id": profile["id"], "source_filter": {},
                "thresholds": DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS,
            }, actor="seed:configs", rationale="default configuration for a vehicle and market with sales")
            for name, weights, cost, default in PROFILES:
                audit.insert(conn, "weight_profile", {
                    "config_id": cfg["id"], "name": name, "case_weights": weights,
                    "brand_multipliers": {"fits": 1.0, "neutral": 0.8, "off_brand": 0.5},
                    "cost_multipliers": cost, "is_default": default, "created_by": "seed:configs",
                }, actor="seed:configs", rationale="default weight profile")
            configs += 1
    return {"configs": configs}


def write_review_files() -> dict:
    fb = [r for v in readers.FEEDBACK_FILES for r in readers.read_feedback(v)]
    topics = Counter(r.topic_l2 if r.topic_l2 else "None" for r in fb)
    attrs = list(dict.fromkeys(s.attribute for s in readers.read_study()))
    return {"catalog": catalog_proposal.write_review_files(topics, attrs), "options": option_load.write_review()}


def seed_all(force: bool = False) -> dict:
    write_review_files()
    out = {}
    out["reference"] = _run("seed:reference", step_reference, force=force)
    out["sales"] = _run("seed:sales", loaders.load_sales, force=force)
    out["features"] = _run("seed:features", step_features, force=force)
    out["study"] = _run("seed:study", loaders.load_study, force=force)

    def options(conn, run):
        ids = {r["name"]: str(r["id"]) for r in conn.execute("select id, name from feature").fetchall()}
        return option_load.load(conn, run, ids)

    out["options"] = _run("seed:option_list", options, force=force)
    out["feedback"] = _run("seed:feedback", loaders.load_feedback, force=force)
    out["configs"] = _run("seed:configs", step_configs, force=force)
    return out


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--review", action="store_true", help="only write the review CSVs")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    started = dt.datetime.now()
    if args.review:
        print(write_review_files())
        return
    seed_all()
    print(f"seed finished in {(dt.datetime.now() - started).seconds} s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Phase 2: seed from the provided data. Counts are checked against
All-context/02-data-provided-by-pm/README.md."""

import pytest

from app.seed import classify, option_lists, readers, registry
from app.config import RAW_DATA_DIR, SOURCES_FILE
from app.seed.option_load import FILES, item_feature, tech_data

README_COUNTS = {
    # vehicle: rows, unique ids, Likes, Difficult to Use, Defect, Wants
    "F70": (4076, 2128, 1630, 595, 491, 273),
    "G60": (5005, 4000, 1951, 1306, 435, 582),
    "G70": (4690, 4000, 1890, 1119, 481, 518),
}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("vehicle", ["F70", "G60", "G70"])
def test_feedback_reader_matches_readme(vehicle):
    rows = readers.read_feedback(vehicle)
    total, ids, likes, dtu, defect, wants = README_COUNTS[vehicle]
    assert len(rows) == total
    assert len({r.verbatim_id for r in rows}) == ids
    types = [r.feedback_type for r in rows]
    assert (types.count("Likes"), types.count("Difficult to Use"), types.count("Defect"), types.count("Wants")) == (
        likes, dtu, defect, wants)


def test_survey_question_prefix_is_stripped_and_answer_is_substring():
    text = 'If there was one comment, what would you want to say to them?\n: "Really love this car!"'
    question, answer = readers.split_question(text)
    assert question.endswith("to them?") and answer == "Really love this car!" and answer in text
    assert readers.split_question("plain text") == (None, "plain text")


def test_sales_reader_flags_suspect_values():
    sales = {(s.vehicle, s.market, s.year): s for s in readers.read_sales()}
    assert sales[("G60", "USA", 2030)].units == 80000
    assert sales[("F70", "China", 2024)].units is None and sales[("F70", "China", 2024)].suspect
    assert sales[("F70", "Rest of World", 2030)].suspect and not sales[("G70", "Rest of World", 2030)].suspect


def test_study_reader_normalizes_both_sheets():
    study = readers.read_study()
    cn_eu = [s for s in study if s.sheet == "CN_EU_2025"]
    us = [s for s in study if s.sheet == "US_2025"]
    assert len(cn_eu) == 37 * 5
    assert len(us) == 2 * len({s.attribute for s in us}) and len(us) > 150
    overall = next(s for s in cn_eu if s.attribute == "Overall product satisfaction" and s.model_label.endswith("G68"))
    assert overall.vehicle == "G60" and overall.market == "China" and abs(overall.normalized - 0.877) < 0.001
    assert all(0 <= s.normalized <= 1 for s in study)
    assert all(s.dissatisfied_share is not None for s in us)


def test_registry_parse_matches_sources_file():
    text = SOURCES_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    sources = registry.parse_sources(text)
    assert len(sources) == 130
    assert len({s["source_id"] for s in sources}) == 130
    assert sum(1 for s in sources if s["enabled"]) == 82  # fetch steps 1 to 9
    competitors = registry.parse_competitors(text)
    assert len(competitors) == 27
    assert {c["bmw_vehicle"] for c in competitors} == {"F70", "G60", "G70"}
    lucid = next(c for c in competitors if c["model"] == "Air")
    assert lucid["not_sold_in"] == ["China"]


def test_option_list_grid_g60():
    items, texts, variants = option_lists.extract(RAW_DATA_DIR / FILES["G60"])
    assert len(variants) == 10 and variants[0] == "i5 eDrive40"
    comfort = next(i for i in items if i.name == "COMFORT PAKET")
    assert comfort.sa_code == "7VB" and comfort.base_price == 2750
    assert comfort.availability["i5 M60 xDrive"] == "optional" and comfort.prices["i5 M60 xDrive"] == 1150
    vent = next(i for i in items if i.name == "Aktive Sitzbelüftung vorn")
    assert vent.package == "COMFORT PAKET" and set(vent.availability.values()) == {"optional"}
    steptronic = next(i for i in items if i.name == "Steptronic Getriebe mit Schaltwippen")
    assert "i5 eDrive40" not in steptronic.availability  # electric models have no gearbox
    assert item_feature("Aktive Sitzbelüftung vorn") == "Seat heating and ventilation"


def test_tech_data_g60_range():
    items, texts, variants = option_lists.extract(RAW_DATA_DIR / FILES["G60"])
    rows = tech_data("G60", texts, variants)
    r = next(r for r in rows if r["variant"] == "i5 eDrive40" and r["metric"] == "electric range WLTP")
    assert r["value"] == 513 and r["value_text"] == "513 – 627"


def test_heuristic_classifier():
    assert classify.heuristic("the screen keeps freezing").kind == "complaint"
    assert classify.heuristic("the screen keeps freezing").severity == "defect"
    assert classify.heuristic("I wish it had a heated steering wheel").kind == "wish"
    assert classify.heuristic("love the seats").kind == "like"
    assert classify.heuristic("it is a car").kind is None


# ---- seeded database -------------------------------------------------------------


def test_seed_counts(sconn):
    q = lambda sql, *p: sconn.execute(sql, p).fetchone()["n"]  # noqa: E731
    assert q("select count(*) n from source_record where source_id = 'bmw_feedback'") == 2128 + 4000 + 4000
    assert q("select count(*) n from signal where record_id like 'bmw_feedback-%%'") == 4076 + 5005 + 4690
    for vehicle, (_, ids, likes, dtu, defect, wants) in README_COUNTS.items():
        assert q("select count(distinct customer_ref) n from signal where vehicle = %s", vehicle) == ids
        got = sconn.execute(
            "select extra->>'feedback_type' t, count(*) n from signal where vehicle = %s group by 1", (vehicle,)
        ).fetchall()
        got = {r["t"]: r["n"] for r in got}
        assert (got["Likes"], got["Difficult to Use"], got["Defect"], got["Wants"]) == (likes, dtu, defect, wants)
    assert q("select count(*) n from source_registry") == 134
    assert q("select count(*) n from competitor") == 27
    assert q("select count(*) n from site_slug") == 231
    assert q("select count(*) n from config") == 10
    assert q("select count(*) n from weight_profile where is_default") == 10
    assert q("select count(*) n from vehicle_feature") > 3000
    assert q("select count(*) n from data_record where source_id = 'bmw_sales'") == 36


def test_every_seed_quote_is_in_its_record(sconn):
    bad = sconn.execute(
        "select count(*) n from signal s join source_record r using (record_id)"
        " where s.quote is not null and strpos(r.text_original, s.quote) = 0"
    ).fetchone()["n"]
    assert bad == 0


def test_every_seeded_row_is_audited(sconn):
    for table, object_type, key in [("signal", "signal", "id::text"), ("source_record", "source_record", "record_id"),
                                    ("vehicle_feature", "vehicle_feature", "id::text"),
                                    ("study_score", "study_score", "id::text")]:
        missing = sconn.execute(
            f"select count(*) n from {table} t where not exists (select 1 from audit_event a"
            f" where a.object_type = %s and a.object_id = t.{key} and a.action = 'create')",
            (object_type,),
        ).fetchone()["n"]
        assert missing == 0, table


def test_markets_and_configs(sconn):
    rows = sconn.execute("select code, markets_sold::text[] m from vehicle where is_current order by code").fetchall()
    assert {r["code"]: sorted(r["m"]) for r in rows} == {
        "F70": ["Europe", "Rest of World"],
        "G60": ["China", "Europe", "Rest of World", "USA"],
        "G70": ["China", "Europe", "Rest of World", "USA"],
    }
    lucid = sconn.execute("select markets::text[] m from competitor where model = 'Air'").fetchone()["m"]
    assert "China" not in lucid
    g60_usa = sconn.execute("select competitor_ids from config where vehicle = 'G60' and market = 'USA'").fetchone()
    assert len(g60_usa["competitor_ids"]) == 11
